subject.title: fix: discord exec approvals fails against local self-signed TLS gateway

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204 as the canonical shared-bootstrap fix, or ask for a clean replacement PR?
rationale: The issue is still valid, but an open proof-positive PR already owns the right shared path and is currently conflicting, so another automated fix PR would duplicate active work.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the shared-bootstrap PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204 as the canonical fix path, resolve conflicts, fix the stale import noted there, and rerun focused gateway/ACP/MCP validation.

options.title: Request a clean replacement
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting branch only after a new PR preserves the same shared resolver scope and proof coverage.

options.title: Defer with issue open
options.body: Keep this issue open without a new fix PR if maintainers want to wait for the contributor, accepting the local TLS approval-client failure remains.

recommendation.title: Adopt and rebase the shared-bootstrap PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204 as the canonical fix path, resolve conflicts, fix the stale import noted there, and rerun focused gateway/ACP/MCP validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The older gateway TLS/auth and approval helper history makes this the best available routing owner for the shared-bootstrap decision.
